name: Iroas
description: Iroas is the centaur-like god of victory, honor and warfare on Theros, patron of Akros and twin of Mogis.

timeline.summary: Elektes and six warriors, inspired by Iroas, found Akros after the war between humans and minotaurs.
timeline.quote: Elektes and six other warriors, inspired by the martial doctrine of Iroas , established the polis of Akros, with Elektes as its first king.

citation.text: "Akros", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Iroas establishes the Iroan Games in Akros to celebrate courage and athletic excellence.
timeline.quote: He established the Iroan Games in Akros to celebrate these ideals

citation.text: "Iroas", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods leaves Iroas and the other deities unable to intervene in mortal affairs, creating challenges for his worshippers.
timeline.quote: Iroas was affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Iroas", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pandamator is hailed as champion of the Iroan Games in Akros, and Iroas is asked to bless him.

citation.text: "I Iroan". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mogis sends minotaur hordes against human cities, with Akros bearing the brunt.
timeline.quote: He began sending hordes of mortal and Nyxborn minotaurs against the human cities.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Iroas and Mogis appear as stars above Akros and grapple, absorbed in their own conflict and not helping mortals.
timeline.quote: The twins were interested in each other, not mortals.

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: The nyxborn blesses Aesrias with Iroas's power, healing him and strengthening him before he faces sirens; Aesrias asks for candle wax for his ears.
timeline.quote: He touched my shoulders. And I felt better. My wounds healed. I was no longer tired.

citation.text: "The Hero of Iroas" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Zosimos, walking by the woods, is overtaken by worry that he will never gain the glory and favor of the gods like other heroes.
timeline.quote: What if he died having never gained the favor of the gods?

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: A satyr springs onto the path, tells Zosimos his mind's garden is full of weeds, and says worry is Phenax's creation that spurns Iroas.
timeline.quote: When you worry, you're actually worshipping Phenax.

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Leandros reaches Akros to find the minotaurs' siege already in progress.
timeline.quote: The minotaurs had built a wall surrounding the city, and he was unable to reach it.

citation.text: "Leandros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Humans and minotaurs wage war over the badlands; Iroas and Mogis and their champions fight, founding Akros and Skophos with Phoberos as border.
timeline.quote: This conflict resulted in the founding of Akros and Skophos

citation.text: "Phoberos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix exerts a binding influence on the borders of the Tovian Fields, preventing the eternal war led by Mogis and Iroas from spreading across Nyx.
timeline.quote: Kruphix claims the borders of the Tovian Fields as his domain

citation.text: "Nyx", section "Locations within Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Some gods circumvent the Silence: Keranos aids Cymede, and Iroas and Mogis appear above the duel of Anax and Rhordon, where Keranos's steam elemental kills Rhordon.
timeline.quote: Keranos retaliated by creating a draconic steam elemental from the river

citation.text: "Silence of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Birth of the Poleis, humans war with the minotaurs in Phoberos and the Katachthon Mountains; Iroas and Mogis reportedly fight over the land, resulting in the founding of Akros and Skophos.
timeline.quote: This conflict resulted in the founding of Akros and Skophos

citation.text: "Skophos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
